import requests
import time
import json
import re
import ipaddress
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from concurrent.futures import as_completed

base_url = "http://10.15.10.142:9000"

headers = {}
headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer cIKi+RWXJiue9fgOCEyljFjOIyGRsEVI"
headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"

v_rule      = "$exec._source.rule.id"
v_level     = "$exec._source.rule.level"
v_srcip     = "$exec._source.data.srcip"
v_agentip   = "$exec._source.agent.ip"
v_agentname = "$exec._source.agent.name"
v_winip     = "$exec._source.data.win.eventdata.ipAddress"

rule_id    = str(v_rule)
rule_level = str(v_level)
srcip      = str(v_srcip)
agent_ip   = str(v_agentip)
agent_name = str(v_agentname)
win_ip     = str(v_winip)

# Choix IP dynamique selon type d'attaque
if srcip and srcip not in ("None", ""):
    ip = srcip        # SQLi → IP attaquant externe
elif win_ip and win_ip not in ("None", ""):
    ip = win_ip       # Brute Force → IP depuis eventdata
else:
    ip = agent_ip     # Fallback → IP agent

try:
    ip_obj = ipaddress.ip_address(ip)
    ip_status = "skipped_private" if ip_obj.is_private else "public"
except:
    ip_status = "invalid_ip"

v1 = "$abuseipdb.body.id"
v2 = "$virustotal_ip.body.id"
v3 = "$virustotal_url.body.id"
v4 = "$create_observable_in_case_ip_attaquant.body.#0._id"

id_abuse  = re.sub("[^0-9]", "", str(v1))
id_vt_ip  = re.sub("[^0-9]", "", str(v2))
id_vt_url = re.sub("[^0-9]", "", str(v3))
clean_obs = re.sub("[^0-9]", "", str(v4))

interval = 5
max_wait = 60

def poll(name, jid):
    elapsed = 0
    if jid == "" or jid == "0":
        return {name: {"status": "Error", "error": "empty job_id", "job_id": "0"}}
    url = base_url + "/api/connector/cortex/job/~" + jid
    while elapsed < max_wait:
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
            s = r.json().get("status", "")
            if s in ("Success", "Failure"):
                return {name: {"status": s, "waited": elapsed, "job_id": jid, "report": r.json().get("report", {})}}
        except Exception as e:
            return {name: {"status": "Error", "error": str(e), "job_id": jid}}
        time.sleep(interval)
        elapsed = elapsed + interval
    return {name: {"status": "Timeout", "waited": elapsed, "job_id": jid}}

jobs = [("abuseipdb", id_abuse), ("virustotal_ip", id_vt_ip), ("virustotal_url", id_vt_url)]

results = {}
pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3)
fs = [pool.submit(poll, n, i) for n, i in jobs]
for f in as_completed(fs):
    results.update(f.result())
pool.shutdown(wait=False)

abuse_job = results.get("abuseipdb", {}).get("job_id", "0")
vtip_job  = results.get("virustotal_ip", {}).get("job_id", "0")
vturl_job = results.get("virustotal_url", {}).get("job_id", "0")

abuse_report = results.get("abuseipdb", {}).get("report", {})
vtip_report  = results.get("virustotal_ip", {}).get("report", {})

abuse_values = abuse_report.get("full", {}).get("values", [{}])
abuse_raw    = abuse_values[0] if abuse_values else {}
abuse_data   = abuse_raw.get("data", abuse_raw)

vtip_full  = vtip_report.get("full", {})
vtip_attrs = vtip_full.get("attributes", {})
vtip_stats = vtip_attrs.get("last_analysis_stats", {})

artifact = {}
artifact["artifact_id"]   = clean_obs
artifact["job_abuseipdb"] = abuse_job
artifact["job_vt_ip"]     = vtip_job
artifact["job_vt_url"]    = vturl_job

enrichment = {}
enrichment["abuse_score"]   = str(abuse_data.get("abuseConfidenceScore", "N/A"))
enrichment["abuse_reports"] = str(abuse_data.get("totalReports", "N/A"))
enrichment["abuse_usage"]   = str(abuse_data.get("usageType", "N/A"))
enrichment["abuse_isp"]     = str(abuse_data.get("isp", "N/A"))
enrichment["abuse_country"] = str(abuse_data.get("countryCode", "N/A"))
enrichment["vt_malicious"]  = str(vtip_stats.get("malicious", "N/A"))
enrichment["vt_harmless"]   = str(vtip_stats.get("harmless", "N/A"))
enrichment["vt_suspicious"] = str(vtip_stats.get("suspicious", "N/A"))
enrichment["vt_asn"]        = str(vtip_attrs.get("asn", "N/A"))
enrichment["vt_country"]    = str(vtip_attrs.get("country", "N/A"))

final = {}
final["rule_id"]        = rule_id
final["rule_level"]     = rule_level
final["ip"]             = ip
final["agent_name"]     = agent_name
final["status"]         = ip_status
final["artifact"]       = artifact
final["enrichment"]     = enrichment
final["abuseipdb"]      = results.get("abuseipdb", {})
final["virustotal_ip"]  = results.get("virustotal_ip", {})
final["virustotal_url"] = results.get("virustotal_url", {})

print(json.dumps(final))

import subprocess
import sys
import json

subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "pywinrm"], capture_output=True)

import winrm

username = "$exec._source.data.win.eventdata.targetUserName"
dc_ip = "10.250.240.4"
password = "Admin@SOC2026!"
ad_user = "Administrateur"

try:
    session = winrm.Session(
        f"http://{dc_ip}:5985/wsman",
        auth=(f"SOC\\{ad_user}", password),
        transport="ntlm"
    )
    result = session.run_ps(
        f"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; "
        f"Disable-ADAccount -Identity {username}; "
        f"(Get-ADUser -Identity {username} -Properties Enabled).Enabled"
    )
    enabled = result.std_out.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()
    stderr = result.std_err.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()
    status = "disabled" if enabled == "False" else "error"
    print(json.dumps({
        "username": username,
        "status": status,
        "enabled": enabled,
        "error": stderr
    }))
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({
        "username": username,
        "status": "error",
        "error": str(e)
    }))
